newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Onfem boosts stake in China road venture.
newsitem.headline: Onfem boosts stake in China road venture.

text.p: Onfem Holdings Ltd said on Friday it had agreed to pay HK$140 million for about four percent of road-developer and toll expressway operator Greater Beijing Region Expressways Ltd (GBRE).
GBRE's controlling shareholder, Miracle Chance Ltd (MCL), had agreed to sell 47,791 GBRE shares to Onfem at about HK$2,929.37 a share, it said in a statement.
It said the deal constituted a discloseable and connected transaction because Onfem independent non-executive director David Ho had an indirect interest in about 35 percent of MCL.

Onfem, which last October announced it would pay HK$200 million for five percent of GBRE, said the latest purchase would leave it with 7.3 percent of GBRE following "recent changes in the asset base of GBRE".
MCL would have about 60 percent of GBRE after the transaction, Onfem said.
Onfem is 58.5-percent owned by China National Nonferrous Metals Industry Corporation.
